episodes.title: I Have a Dream
episodes.summary: The Healer works on a case that becomes harder than it should have been. Reporters Moon Ho and Young Shin work on their stories from very different levels in their careers.

episodes.title: Fate Continues
episodes.summary: The Healer's current assignment involves both Moon Ho and Young Shin.

episodes.title: The First Kiss That Day
episodes.summary: As the Healer gets closer to Young Shin, he continues to wonder how she knows about him and why.

episodes.title: Because I'm Next to You
episodes.summary: Jung Ho, now undercover as Bong Soo, continues to bond with Yong Shin as colleagues.

episodes.title: Meaning of You
episodes.summary: Healer has now tied himself to Young Shin after he intervened on her behalf during an attack.

episodes.title: Begin
episodes.summary: Young Shin's story is turning out to be a bigger handful than she ever expected. Healer learns that someone is out to get him.

episodes.title: We, Under the Sunset
episodes.summary: Mun-sik orders a background check on Yeong-sin to see if she was adopted. Mun-ho tasks Bong-su with uncovering Hwang Je-guk's licentious private life. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Cannot Be Forgotten
episodes.summary: Shocked to see an email notification for Mun-ho sent from Healer, Yeong-sin interrogates Mun-ho about his relationship with Healer.

episodes.title: I Trust You
episodes.summary: Mun-ho threatens to tell Myeong-hui everything if something happens to Ji-an again. Mun-sik is running out of time to turn in Ko Seong-cheol's killer.

episodes.title: Can't It Be Me?
episodes.summary: At Someday News, everyone eagerly awaits Yeong-sin's reporting. Mun-sik and Boss watch the live broadcast of Kim Ui-chan's candidacy announcement.

episodes.title: In the Darkness
episodes.summary: Back home from work, Mun-ho discovers that there's been an intruder and receives a call from a restricted number asking about what happened in 1992.

episodes.title: I Don't Know How to Escape
episodes.summary: Mun-ho is furious at his brother for coming to visit Someday News. Jeong-hu meets one of his father's close friends.

episodes.title: I'm Waiting
episodes.summary: Bae Sang-su is confident that he has finally caught Healer. Mun-sik arrives at the Double S Guard's headquarters to meet the man they brought in

episodes.title: It's Alright Even If You Cry
episodes.summary: Ms. Jo tries to hack into the police server to obtain Yeong-jae's statement. Yeong-sin gets worried when Bong-su becomes unreachable.

episodes.title: I Remember
episodes.summary: Jeong-hu contemplates how he'll reveal his truest self to Yeong-sin -- and when. Someday News prepares its attack on Mun-sik's campaign

episodes.title: To You Again
episodes.summary: Jeong-hu follows a lead given by Mun-ho to find the truth behind his father's case. Ms. Jo notices something off about Yeong-sin's location tracker.

episodes.title: Won't You Answer Me?
episodes.summary: Yeong-sin's stunned face replays in Jeong-hu's mind, but he tries to focus on getting his father's statement. Yeong-sin visits Myeong-hui at home.

episodes.title: Just Like the Others
episodes.summary: Jeong-hu confronts Boss. Fearing for Jeong-hu's safety, Yeong-sin tries to follow him inside. Mun-ho airs the content of the audiotape on live news.

episodes.title: I'll Protect You
episodes.summary: Tracking the location of Mun-ho's phone, Jeong-hu arrives at Someday to find that no one's there. Mun-ho's phone rings, but the caller ID is blocked.

episodes.title: Goodbye Healer
episodes.summary: Jeong-hu resorts to plan B when he hits roadblocks trying to prove his innocence and the people closest to him come under attack.
